svg.title: Diabatic compressed-air energy storage
svg.desc: ISO 1219-style hydraulic circuit schematic generated by hydraulify.

g.text: Two-stage compression with intercooling and aftercooling, water-compensated store, flue-gas preheated expansion on a shared motor-generator
Units: SI (bar, L/min, mm) | ISO 1219-style schematic
MG1: One motor-generator serves both modes, with a clutch to the expander and a clutch to the LP compressor; only one clutch is engaged at a time.
HX3: The preheater is fired by flue gas from outside the drawing, which is what makes the plant diabatic.
C2: The HP stage has its own motor, because a compressor has one shaft end and the LP stage takes the shared machine's.
ACC1: Drawn as direct contact, air over water with no separator, as a water-compensated store is built.
T1: Drawn in the ISO 1219 fluid-power form; set meta.machine_style to iso10628 for the process-plant trapezoid.
